_Europa Report_ (2013, dir. Sebastián Cordero)
Why it fits
It shares the grounded, scientifically curious core you appreciate: an international crew of
astronauts and researchers journeys to Jupiter’s moon Europa to search for signs of life.
When communications fail and equipment malfunctions threaten the mission, the crew doesn’t descend
into manufactured interpersonal drama, panic, or cynicism. Instead, they act like real scientists
and engineers—responding to high-stakes crises with composure, intellectual rigor, mutual trust, and
an unwavering dedication to discovery. It’s an understated, tightly paced hard sci-fi procedural
that respects competence and empathy.
